name: cwe_89_sqli_multifile
description: SQL injection across 3 files: Flask route → user service → DB layer. Taint flows through 2 function calls without sanitization.
why_multifile: grep for 'execute(f"' would miss this: the f-string is in user_service.py but the user input is tainted in app.py. Only belief propagation across the call graph catches it.
